title: Movie Buffs
blurb: Quote machines, sequel defenders, popcorn thieves and the one who cries at cartoons.

questions.text: Who would cry first at the end of an animated movie about a toy?

Who would fall asleep in the cinema and snore?

Who would be most likely to walk out of a movie in the middle?

Who's the one most likely to say "the book was better" about a book they never read?
Who would be most likely to pick the worst movie for movie night?
